title.en: Give it what it asks for

after.zh: 一轮一轮：模型提要求，你去拿，结果放回上下文，再调用。它第一次写的看起来对，测试却没过；把失败的测试报告放回上下文，它就改对了。刚才你做的，就是一个 agent 循环：每一轮调用一次模型，做它要的事，把结果接回去。
after.en: Turn after turn: the model asks, you fetch, the result goes back into its context, and you call again. Its first try looked right and failed the tests; with the failing report in its context, it got it right. What you just did is an agent loop: each turn, one model call, do what it asks, feed the result back.

brief.zh: 这次模型会提要求：要目录、要文件。照着它的要求给，直到测试通过。
brief.en: This time the model asks: for the file list, for a file. Give it what it asks for, until the tests pass.

hint.zh: 模型要目录时，按目录按钮，把仓库的文件列表放进上下文。
hint.en: When the model asks for the files, press File list to put the repository’s list into its context.

hint.zh: 它说做完了，不一定真做完了。
hint.en: It says it is done; that does not make it done.
